description: Helper functions and classes for Redux actions in Mattermost, including error handling, client function binding, debounce utility, and a custom error class.

classes.name: FormattedError
classes.description: Custom error class with internationalization support, extending the standard Error class.

methods.name: forceLogoutIfNecessary
methods.description: Checks error response and logs out user if unauthorized.

methods.name: requestFailure
methods.description: Creates a failure action with error information.

methods.name: bindClientFunc
methods.description: Wraps a client function to dispatch request, success, or failure actions, handling errors and logout if necessary.
